calculation.description: At each completed date, measure each asset's three-day return relative to the cross-sectional median, reverse the standardized dispersion move, and grade by its absolute deviation. Higher scores favor unusually weak assets for reversal while penalizing low-dispersion observations.

validation.regime_notes: Positive IC and ICIR across 2020-2022, 2023-2024, 2025-2026, and the 2026-07 onward segment; small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
